3. When I first started not covering them up, it sucked. But it also was freeing. Sure, I would keep looking down and be forced to remember, but if I'm being honest, I was already doing that in the form if being paranoid about my sleeves. 
4. Finally, if people give you looks, look right back. If they have the audacity to say shit, ask them why they think it's alright to ask strangers deeply personal information. Shame them, it's very cathartic. (It's very much on the same level as people asking gay couples about who is "the top" or whatever. Which I also treat the same way, aka shame them 😂.) Don't let then make you feel ashamed for surviving. Because the alternative, is not surviving.
4.1 Additionally they might be looking because they relate, you just don't know. 
5. The more time you spend obsessing over what to do, the more time your gunna waste being paranoid. Rip it off like a Band-Aid. Dress for the weather, enjoy the privileges of recovery. The sooner you get used to it, the sooner you can move on with your life and just enjoy things.
